payload.name: Preserve-all-explicitly-named-activities-in-event-memories
payload.description: When extracting an event memory from messages that explicitly name multiple activities (such as tours, classes, or visits), use this to ensure every named activity is retained before ADD or UPDATE.
content: During extraction, when multiple messages describe the same trip or event, read each explicitly stated activity and include all of them in the single event memory; do not summarize away any explicitly named activity.
Before an ADD decision, re-scan the source messages and verify each explicitly named activity appears in the candidate content; if one is missing, amend the candidate rather than dropping it.
When a later message names another activity for an existing event memory, issue an UPDATE to append only that missing activity, keeping the memory compact; do not create a duplicate memory.

solves: A consolidated event memory produced from several messages can omit one explicitly named activity when the extractor summarizes the turn. This skill applies when a future session describes one trip or event across multiple messages that explicitly list several activities, and those messages are merged into a single event memory; before any ADD or UPDATE, the extractor must verify each explicitly named activity is preserved. It must not apply when no explicit enumeration exists, when activities are only implied, or when the base policy already retains all named items without consolidation.
